This demon was summoned to destroy Varrock only to be thwarted by... a talented adventurer. Not many people know that he originated in the infernal dimensions as a demon lord. Hopefully this time around any adventurer will find it easier.

Quest: Demon Slayer

Combat: A Demon with devilish melee attacks! This demon can only be banished by dealing the killing blow with Silverlight (weapon provided in arena).
